vocabulary.meaning_en: meat from a cow
vocabulary.note_ar: الحيوان cow لكن لحمه beef (من الفرنسية)
vocabulary.example: This burger is made of beef.
vocabulary.note_en: The animal is a "cow", but its meat is "beef" (from French).

vocabulary.meaning_en: a farm bird, or its meat
vocabulary.note_ar: نفس الاسم للحيوان واللحم
vocabulary.example: We had grilled chicken for lunch.
vocabulary.note_en: The same word for the animal and its meat.

vocabulary.meaning_en: a young sheep, or its meat
vocabulary.note_ar: حرف b صامت: تُنطق /læm/
vocabulary.example: Lamb with rice is a popular dish.
vocabulary.note_en: The b is silent: say /læm/.

vocabulary.meaning_en: meat from an older sheep
vocabulary.note_ar: من الفرنسية mouton
vocabulary.example: Mutton needs to cook for a long time.
vocabulary.note_en: From the French word "mouton".

vocabulary.meaning_en: meat from a pig
vocabulary.note_ar: الحيوان pig لكن لحمه pork (من الفرنسية)
vocabulary.example: Check the label if you don't eat pork.
vocabulary.note_en: The animal is a "pig", but its meat is "pork" (from French).

vocabulary.meaning_en: a thick slice of meat, usually beef
vocabulary.example: How would you like your steak cooked?

vocabulary.meaning_en: a large bird, or its meat
vocabulary.example: Many families eat turkey on holidays.

vocabulary.meaning_en: minced meat inside a long thin skin
vocabulary.example: He put some sausages on the grill.

vocabulary.meaning_en: salted, smoked meat from a pig's belly or back
vocabulary.note_ar: يُطبخ قبل الأكل؛ أغلبه من الخنزير
vocabulary.example: The breakfast menu has eggs and bacon.
vocabulary.note_en: It is cooked before eating; it usually comes from pigs.

vocabulary.meaning_en: dried, smoked meat that is ready to eat
vocabulary.note_ar: beef jerky من اللحم البقري ويؤكل مباشرة من الكيس
vocabulary.example: I took some beef jerky on the hiking trip.
vocabulary.note_en: "Beef jerky" is made from beef and is eaten straight from the bag.

vocabulary.meaning_en: smoked meat from a pig's leg
vocabulary.note_ar: bacon من البطن ومملّح، و ham من الفخذ
vocabulary.example: The sandwich had ham and cheese in it.
vocabulary.note_en: Bacon comes from the belly and is salted; ham comes from the back leg.

vocabulary.meaning_en: the bones around the chest, cooked with their meat
vocabulary.note_ar: المفرد rib
vocabulary.example: These lamb ribs are delicious.
vocabulary.note_en: Singular: rib.

vocabulary.meaning_en: meat cut into very small pieces
vocabulary.note_ar: mince (minced meat) بريطاني من الفعل mince = يفرم؛ ground meat أمريكي من grind = يطحن
vocabulary.example: I need half a kilo of ground beef for the burgers.
vocabulary.note_en: "Mince" (minced meat) is British, from the verb "mince" (to cut into tiny pieces). "Ground meat" is American, from "grind".

vocabulary.meaning_en: an animal that lives in water, or its meat
vocabulary.note_ar: نفس الاسم للحيوان واللحم
vocabulary.example: We eat fish every Friday.
vocabulary.note_en: The same word for the animal and its meat.

vocabulary.meaning_en: a large fish with pink flesh
vocabulary.note_ar: حرف l صامت: تُنطق /ˈsæmən/، والكلمة من الفرنسية
vocabulary.example: Grilled salmon is rich in protein.
vocabulary.note_en: The l is silent: say /ˈsæmən/. The word comes from French.

vocabulary.meaning_en: a large sea fish often sold in cans
vocabulary.example: I made a tuna sandwich.

vocabulary.meaning_en: a small sea animal with a shell that we eat
vocabulary.example: The shrimp were cooked with garlic.

vocabulary.meaning_en: a large shrimp
vocabulary.example: She ordered grilled king prawns.

vocabulary.meaning_en: a sea animal with a hard shell and claws
vocabulary.example: A crab walked sideways on the sand.

vocabulary.meaning_en: a large sea animal with big claws, an expensive food
vocabulary.example: Lobster is the most expensive dish on the menu.

vocabulary.meaning_en: a piece of meat or fish with no bones
vocabulary.note_ar: بريطاني: /ˈfɪlɪt/ مع نطق t، أمريكي: /fɪˈleɪ/ بدون t
vocabulary.example: I'll have the fish fillet with salad.
vocabulary.note_en: British: /ˈfɪlɪt/ with the t; American: /fɪˈleɪ/ without the t.

vocabulary.meaning_en: fish and shellfish eaten as food
vocabulary.example: This restaurant is famous for its seafood.

vocabulary.meaning_en: a soft yellow food made from cream
vocabulary.example: Spread some butter on the bread.

vocabulary.meaning_en: the thick fatty part of milk
vocabulary.example: Do you want cream in your coffee?

vocabulary.meaning_en: a thick food made from milk
vocabulary.note_ar: تُنطق /ˈjoʊɡərt/ (أشيع) أو /ˈjɒɡət/، والاثنان صحيحان
vocabulary.example: I eat yogurt with honey for breakfast.
vocabulary.note_en: Say /ˈjoʊɡərt/ (more common) or /ˈjɒɡət/; both are correct.

vocabulary.meaning_en: cream that has a slightly sour taste
vocabulary.example: Serve the potatoes with sour cream.

vocabulary.meaning_en: a soft white cheese with small lumps
vocabulary.note_ar: cottage = بيت ريفي صغير، كانت تُصنع فيه
vocabulary.example: Cottage cheese is low in fat.
vocabulary.note_en: A "cottage" is a small house in the countryside, where this cheese was made.

vocabulary.meaning_en: a substance in food that helps the body grow
vocabulary.example: Eggs are a good source of protein.

vocabulary.meaning_en: to enter a place very quickly
vocabulary.note_ar: rush = يُسرع
vocabulary.example: He rushed in, holding a big box.
vocabulary.note_en: rush = to move or do something very quickly.

vocabulary.meaning_en: to tell people something officially or proudly
vocabulary.note_ar: الاسم: announcement
vocabulary.example: She proudly announced that she had found a new job.
vocabulary.note_en: Noun: announcement.

vocabulary.meaning_en: to state something firmly and seriously
vocabulary.note_ar: أكثر رسمية وجدية من announce: declare war
vocabulary.example: The country declared its independence in 1960.
vocabulary.note_en: More formal and serious than "announce": declare war.

vocabulary.meaning_en: a cardboard box for milk or juice
vocabulary.example: We need a carton of milk.

vocabulary.meaning_en: a shop that sells meat
vocabulary.note_ar: butcher = جزّار
vocabulary.example: I bought fresh lamb from the butcher's shop.
vocabulary.note_en: A butcher is a person who cuts and sells meat.

vocabulary.meaning_en: to bring something to a person or place
vocabulary.note_ar: الاسم: delivery
vocabulary.example: They deliver pizza until midnight.
vocabulary.note_en: Noun: delivery.

vocabulary.meaning_en: to cook food over direct heat; the equipment for this
vocabulary.example: Let's grill some fish tonight.

vocabulary.meaning_en: a flat dish you eat from
vocabulary.example: Put the plates on the table, please.

vocabulary.meaning_en: to stop moving suddenly; to become ice
vocabulary.note_ar: freeze - froze - frozen؛ الشرطة تقول Freeze! = لا تتحرك
vocabulary.example: Everyone froze when they heard the noise.
vocabulary.note_en: freeze - froze - frozen. When police shout "Freeze!" it means "Don't move!"

vocabulary.meaning_en: doing things secretly so others don't notice
vocabulary.note_ar: من الفعل sneak = يتسلل
vocabulary.example: A sneaky dog ate my sandwich.
vocabulary.note_en: From the verb "sneak" = to move quietly so no one sees you.

vocabulary.meaning_en: the main meal of the day
vocabulary.note_ar: أصل معناها الوجبة الرئيسية في أي وقت، وليس العشاء بالضرورة
vocabulary.example: We had dinner at three o'clock on Friday.
vocabulary.note_en: Originally it meant the main meal of the day at any time, not necessarily the evening meal.

fine_lines.title: lamb vs mutton
fine_lines.explanation_ar: الفرق في عمر الحيوان. lamb لحم خروف صغير عمره أقل من سنة، لحمه طري وفاتح اللون. mutton لحم خروف كبير، لونه أغمق وطعمه أقوى ويحتاج وقتاً أطول في الطبخ.

examples.sentence: These lamb chops are very tender.
Mutton curry cooks slowly for hours.

fine_lines.explanation_en: The difference is the animal's age. "Lamb" is meat from a young sheep, less than a year old; it is soft and light in color. "Mutton" is meat from an older sheep; it is darker, has a stronger taste, and needs longer to cook.

fine_lines.title: shrimp vs prawn
fine_lines.explanation_ar: الفرق هنا في الحجم: shrimp للجمبري الصغير، و prawn للجمبري الكبير.

examples.sentence: There are tiny shrimp in this rice.

fine_lines.explanation_en: The difference here is size: "shrimp" are small, and "prawns" are big.

fine_lines.title: bacon vs ham vs jerky
fine_lines.explanation_ar: bacon و ham كلاهما لحم خنزير مدخّن: bacon مملّح ومن منطقة البطن ويحتاج طبخاً، و ham من الفخذ. أما jerky فلحم مجفف مدخّن، وغالباً يكون beef jerky من اللحم البقري ويؤكل مباشرة.

examples.sentence: The bacon is still frying in the pan.
This sandwich has ham in it.
I always keep beef jerky in my bag.

fine_lines.explanation_en: Bacon and ham are both smoked pork: bacon is salted, comes from the belly, and needs cooking; ham comes from the back leg. "Jerky" is dried, smoked meat, usually beef jerky, and you eat it as it is.

fine_lines.title: mince vs ground meat
fine_lines.explanation_ar: المعنى واحد: لحم مفروم. البريطاني يراه «مفروماً» فيقول mince أو minced meat من الفعل mince. الأمريكي يراه «مطحوناً» فيقول ground meat، و ground هنا التصريف الثالث من grind (يطحن) وليست «أرض».

examples.sentence: Buy some mince for the pie. (UK)
Mix the ground meat with onions. (US)

fine_lines.explanation_en: Same meaning: meat cut into very small pieces. The British say "mince" or "minced meat", from the verb "mince". Americans say "ground meat"; here "ground" is the past participle of "grind", not the noun meaning the earth.

fine_lines.title: announce vs declare
fine_lines.explanation_ar: الاثنان بمعنى «يُعلن». announce إعلان خبر للناس بشكل عام. declare أكثر جدية ورسمية وفيها نوع من السلطة، لذلك نقول declare war وليس announce war.

examples.sentence: The pilot announced that we would land soon.
The king declared war on his neighbors.

fine_lines.explanation_en: Both mean to make something known publicly. "Announce" is for telling people news in general. "Declare" is more serious and official and shows authority, so we say "declare war", not "announce war".

expressions.meaning_ar: طبق يجمع بين المأكولات البحرية (surf) واللحم (turf)
expressions.example: I'll have the surf and turf: steak with prawns.
expressions.meaning_en: a meal with both seafood (surf) and meat (turf)

expressions.example: My mother is the one who brings home the bacon.
expressions.meaning_en: to earn money to support your family

expressions.example: He works two jobs to put bread on the table.
expressions.meaning_en: to earn enough money to feed your family

expressions.example: She earns a living as a photographer.
expressions.meaning_en: to earn the money you need to live

expressions.example: We arrived just in time for the movie.
expressions.meaning_en: at the last possible moment, not late

expressions.example: I was about to call you.
expressions.meaning_en: going to do something very soon

grammar.title: Present perfect with since and for
grammar.explanation_ar: الاستخدام الثاني للمضارع التام: حدث بدأ في الماضي وما زال مستمراً حتى الآن. تخيّل كاميرا فيديو: since هي لحظة بداية الفيديو (منذ)، و for هي طول الشريط الذي مرّ حتى الآن (لمدة). الحدث قد يستمر في المستقبل أيضاً.
examples: I have studied programming for one year.
My father has worked at the same company since 1990.
grammar.explanation_en: The second use of the present perfect: something started in the past and is still continuing now. Imagine a video camera: "since" is the moment the video started, and "for" is how long it has been recording until now. The action may also continue into the future.

grammar.title: Past simple for finished events
grammar.explanation_ar: الماضي البسيط لحدث انتهى وانقطع (كأنه صورة لا فيديو)، خاصة مع وقت محدد مثل ago أو in 2015. ago تعني «مضت» وتأتي بعد المدة: three hours ago. وإذا مات الشخص فقد توقفت «كاميرا حياته» فنستخدم الماضي البسيط: Shakespeare wrote many plays.
examples: I finished my homework three hours ago.
grammar.explanation_en: Use the past simple for an action that is finished and cut off from now (like a photo, not a video), especially with a specific time like "ago" or "in 2015". "Ago" comes after the length of time: three hours ago. If a person has died, the "camera of their life" has stopped, so we use the past simple: Shakespeare wrote many plays.

grammar.title: Past perfect (introduction)
grammar.explanation_ar: had + التصريف الثالث نستخدمه لحدث وقع قبل حدث آخر في الماضي. سيُشرح بالتفصيل لاحقاً.
examples: He had prepared the food before his friends arrived.
grammar.explanation_en: We use had + past participle for something that happened before another event in the past. This will be explained in detail later.

questions.question: Meat from a cow is called:
questions.explanation_en: The animal is a cow, and its meat is beef.

questions.question: Which word has a silent letter?
Meat from an older sheep is:
questions.explanation_ar: mutton لحم خروف كبير، و lamb لحم خروف صغير.
questions.explanation_en: Mutton is meat from an older sheep; lamb is from a young sheep.

questions.question: In American English, minced meat is usually called:
questions.explanation_ar: ground meat أمريكي (من grind = يطحن)، و mince بريطاني.
questions.explanation_en: "Ground meat" is American (from grind); "mince" is British.

questions.question: She ___ in this house since she was a child.
questions.explanation_ar: مع since وحدث ما زال مستمراً نستخدم المضارع التام.
questions.explanation_en: With "since" and an action that is still continuing, we use the present perfect.

questions.question: I finished my homework three hours ___.
questions.explanation_en: "Ago" comes after the length of time and means "before now".

questions.question: I have worked here ___ five years.
questions.explanation_ar: for مع طول المدة، و since مع نقطة البداية.
questions.explanation_en: Use "for" with a length of time and "since" with a starting point.

questions.question: "He brings home the bacon" means he:
questions.explanation_en: It means he earns the money to support his family.

questions.question: A dish with steak and prawns together is called:
The country ___ war on its enemy.
questions.explanation_ar: declare أكثر رسمية وسلطة، ونقول declare war.
questions.explanation_en: "Declare" is more formal and shows authority; we say "declare war".
